distributions.name: σ (\bar\nu_\mu restricted PS)
distributions.provenance: T2K:2017bvo — numu and antinumu CC-inclusive cross sections per nucleon, T2K ND280 off-axis P0D water-target-region material (H 8%, C 45%, O 29.9%, Cu 14.3%, plus Cl/Ti/Zn; not pure H2O), single flux-averaged value; primary results are the model-independent restricted phase space σ with θ_mu<32° and p_mu>500 MeV/c (Table VII); transcribed from the paper · the full-phase-space values are NEUT-extrapolated by the total/restricted ratio and are model-dependent (assumed M_A^QE and 2p2h C/O parameters)
distributions.notes: The full-phase-space values are NEUT-extrapolated by the total/restricted ratio and are model-dependent (assumed M_A^QE and 2p2h C/O parameters).
